info.title: MCP Gateway Token Exchange
info.description: An MCP Gateway that fronts a self-hosted MCP server exposing a single `echo` tool. The gateway authenticates callers via Auth0 (`mcp-auth0-oauth-inbound`), exchanges its own Auth0 client credentials for a token it attaches to the upstream call (`upstream-oauth-client-credentials-inbound`), and gates the `echo` tool behind an `echo` role (`mcp-capability-filter-inbound`).

post.description: Forwards to Zuplo's public echo/reflector service (https://echo.zuplo.io), which echoes back the request it received — including whatever `Authorization` header was attached. Used as the MCP `echo` tool; this is also the hop the Auth0 token exchange happens on, so the exchanged token is visible in the reflected `headers.authorization` of the response.

200.description: The reflected request, as returned by echo.zuplo.io

post.description: The real MCP server exposing the `echo` tool: translates a `tools/call` for `echo` into the `/echo` API call, which forwards to https://echo.zuplo.io. Same-project, same-trust-boundary hop from `/mcp` — no separate credential needed here; the token exchange happens one hop further out, on `/echo`, for the call to the external echo.zuplo.io service.

get,post.description: Public entry point for MCP clients. Authenticates the caller via Auth0 browser login and only exposes/allows the `echo` tool to callers whose `roles` claim includes `echo`.

tags.name: Echo
